title: OpenBulanci pak manifest
description: Per-pak manifest (the project's own package.json for an asset/content pak). A pak is a layered content package: 'master' is the base game, 'mod' paks override entries from any lower pak (GZDoom load-order style) and may add brand new assets. Dev form is a folder; dist form is a compiled binary pak. Names live here (dev only); the pak compiler resolves them to hashes and strips them so dist binaries carry no slugs/paths.

id.description: Stable pak identifier. 'master' is reserved for the base game.

kind.description: 'master' is the base game (embedded pack); 'mod' layers over lower paks.

engine.description: Engine/format compatibility range this pak targets, e.g. '^0.1'.

dependsOn.description: Pak ids that must be present and mounted below this one.

loadAfter.description: Pak ids this pak must mount after (load-order constraint; can reference other mods, not just master).

assets.description: This pak's contribution to the merged catalog: new and overriding assets, keyed by 16-hex blake2b-64('<folder>/<slug>') handle hash.

file.description: Path of the content file inside this pak folder (hash-named '<hash>.<ext>' or a friendly path).

overrides.description: true when this entry shadows a hash provided by a lower pak; false for a brand-new asset.

scenes.description: Scenes/levels this pak provides, keyed by scene name. A scene is either a legacy single Luau module (`file`), or declarative: a control-tree document (`doc`, a *.scene.json) plus attached code-behind scripts (`scripts`). Luau ships as stripped bytecode; the doc ships as JSON. Both are addressed by the literal path the SceneManager reads (`scenes/<name>.scene.json`, the script paths).

file.description: Legacy single-module scene: a Luau source path inside this pak folder (built imperatively).

doc.description: Declarative scene document path inside this pak folder (a *.scene.json control tree).

scripts.description: Attached code-behind Luau scripts for a declarative scene, run in order after the tree is built.

hash.description: For a legacy `file` scene: the blake2b-64('scenes/<name>') handle it resolves under (defaulted from the name otherwise).

levels.description: Declarative levels this pak provides, keyed by level name. A level is sim-adjacent content (collision obstacles, spawn points, tunable params) authored as a *.level.json document and addressed by the literal path the engine reads ('levels/<name>.level.json'). Unlike scenes (UI control trees fed to the renderer), levels feed the gameplay simulation and are HMR-patched with a level/sim op vocabulary rather than scene ops.

doc.description: Declarative level document path inside this pak folder (a *.level.json).

scripts.description: Attached gamemode/code-behind Luau scripts for this level, run after the level loads.
